title: Property on the overlap of a quasi-compact and affine open
statement: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, P a property of opens, and assume P on affine opens and the gluing implication. Then P holds on the intersection of every quasi-compact open U with every affine open V.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 08DR proof, second paragraph

proof.text: Set W = U ∩ V. Apply Mathlib QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact to the open sets U and V, using hU and IsAffineOpen.isCompact hV. This proves compactness of W directly, without choosing a finite affine cover.

The inclusion f : W.toScheme → V.toScheme is X.homOfLE inf_le_right and is an open immersion, hence a monomorphism and separated by Mathlib IsSeparated.isSeparated_of_mono. Since V is affine, its terminal morphism is separated. Compose these separated morphisms and use terminal.comp_from to obtain W.toScheme.IsSeparated. This is the composition form of lem-sc-separated-over-affine-scheme-separated.
Apply separated_quasiCompact_open_induction with the unchanged ambient scheme, property, affine hypothesis and gluing hypothesis, to W and the compactness and separatedness proved above.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 08DR proof, second paragraph; compactness implemented directly using Mathlib QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact, and separatedness by composition into the affine open.
